title: Full faithfulness of finite etale restriction over a proper henselian pair
statement: Let (A,I) be a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], f:Y → Spec A proper [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and i:Y₀ → Y its closed fibre. Base change i* on finite etale schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] is fully faithful: each morphism on the closed fibre lifts uniquely.

source.place: Tag 0GS2, full faithfulness; the clopen/rank proof follows the corrected blueprint proof steps 1–6

proof.text: For finite etale U,V over Y, form P=V×Y U and its base change P0. The product projection square is cartesian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-graph-base-change]. Paste the U closed-fibre square and then the given Y square using [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting]. Since U and P are proper over A by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence], apply [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-clopen-restriction] to U and P. This gives clopen injectivity on U and a clopen bijection on P.

The equivalences of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-graph-clopen] identify each Hom set with the clopen pieces of P or P0 whose projection is an isomorphism. Their images commute with base change by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-graph-base-change]. For a clopen W of P, its restricted projection is finite etale and its rank commutes with the closed fibre by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-clopen-restriction-rank].

Prove the restricted projection is an isomorphism iff its closed fibre is: ranks of an isomorphism are one and the rank-one locus is clopen by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-flat-rank-iso]. If the fibre has rank one, inverse images of this locus and all of U agree. Clopen injectivity on U forces the rank-one locus to equal U. The rank-one criterion then gives the isomorphism. This is the proved private rank_one_of_clopen_injective helper, with no assumption that the closed fibre is surjective.

Injectivity of Hom restriction follows from clopen injectivity on P and injectivity of the graph equivalence. For surjectivity, lift the clopen graph of the given fibre morphism by clopen surjectivity on P; its projection is an isomorphism by the previous step. Use the inverse graph equivalence to recover a morphism, and image compatibility plus injectivity of the fibre graph equivalence verifies its restriction is the specified morphism. Finally identify these raw over-Y morphisms with MorphismProperty.Over morphisms and use Full and Faithful to construct FullyFaithful.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GS2; corrected blueprint steps 1–6, formalized by K1 using clopen graphs and rank-one locus injectivity

    {Y Y₀ : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f] (i : Y₀ ⟶ Y)
    (f₀ : Y₀ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ I)))
    (h : IsPullback i f₀ f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) :
    letI := hstable
    Nonempty (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale) ⊤ i).FullyFaithful
